web.command.clear.desc: Start a new conversation; the current one stays saved in Sessions
web.command.retry.desc: Ask the last turn again, the same way, in place of its reply
web.command.rewind.desc: Remove the last turns from this conversation (the conversation only: files stay as they are)
web.command.plan.desc: Plan first: show the current plan, or run a task plan-first
web.command.clear.kept: New conversation started. The previous one stays saved as %s in Sessions.
web.command.rewind.usage: Usage: /rewind [n] removes the last n turns (default 1) from this conversation. Undoing a compaction (/rewind compact) is only available in the terminal.
web.command.rewind.nothing: There are no turns to rewind in this conversation.
web.command.rewind.done: Rewound %d turn(s) (%d messages). Only the conversation rewinds: files a coder turn changed stay as they are.
web.command.retry.nothing: There is no turn to retry in this conversation yet.
web.command.retry.restored: The retry did not complete, so the previous reply was kept.
web.command.plan.none: No plan in this conversation yet: plans appear in the plan panel while a coder or agent turn works.
web.command.plan.shown: The plan panel shows the latest plan of this conversation (%d step(s)).
web.command.plan.how: Run a task plan-first with /plan <task> (agent) or /plan coder <task>; preview a plan without running it with /plan preview <task>.
web.command.jobs.terminal_only: /jobs %s changes scheduler jobs, which is done from the terminal. The page reads them: /jobs list, show, tree, logs and history.
web.command.schedule.in_process: This job runs in the scheduler of this web process and stops with it. To keep jobs running and share them with the terminal, start the scheduler daemon (chatcli daemon start).
web.command.refuse.exit: %s does not apply here: close the tab to leave the page, or stop chatcli web (Ctrl+C where it runs, or /web stop in the terminal that opened it).
web.command.refuse.menu: %s opens the terminal's menu. Here, type / for the command list or open Panel → Commands.
web.command.refuse.update: %s replaces the running binary, so it runs in the terminal. Restart the web UI afterwards.
web.command.refuse.auth: %s runs an interactive login, which needs the terminal. Log in there, then restart the web UI to use the new credentials.
web.command.refuse.daemon: %s starts or drives a long-running process tied to the terminal, so it runs there.
web.command.refuse.worktree: %s switches the terminal session's working tree, so it runs in the terminal.
web.command.refuse.reload: %s reloads the terminal's configuration. To pick up configuration changes here, restart the web UI (/web stop, then /web).
web.command.refuse.wait: %s holds the conversation until a condition is met (up to 45 minutes), and the page runs one turn at a time. Schedule the wait instead with /schedule <name> --wait <condition>, and follow it with /jobs.
web.command.refuse.chunks: %s belongs to the terminal's large-file flow, which the page does not use. To ask the last turn again, use /retry.
web.command.refuse.redraw: %s redraws the terminal screen; the page has nothing to redraw. To start a new conversation, use /clear.
